meta.title: Link — Short links, free forever
meta.description: Custom aliases, real analytics, QR codes, passwords and a public API. The Bitly alternative that costs zero.

hero.sub: Everything Bitly charges $35 a month for — custom aliases, click analytics, QR codes, expiring links and a real API — rebuilt, open sourced and set free. Already live.

f1.d: Pick your own slug: zs.ai/launch reads better than seven random characters. Brand it, remember it, share it.

f2.d: Clicks by day, referrer, country, device, browser and OS. Cookie-less, fingerprint-less, honest.

f3.d: Every link gets an instant QR in SVG or PNG. Print it, project it, ship it.

f4.d: Lock a link with a password. Only the people you choose get through.

f5.d: Set an expiry date or a maximum click count. The link retires itself.

f6.d: Tag links by campaign, client or channel. Find anything in seconds.

f7.d: Build campaign URLs without a spreadsheet. Source, medium, campaign — done.

f8.d: Create and measure links from your code with a simple REST API and personal keys.

f9.d: Everything is yours. Export it, back it up, take it home. No hostages.

compare.note: Bitly Core costs $35 a month — $420 a year, every year. A 10-person team on per-seat pricing easily crosses $4,200 a year. Link costs $0. Forever.

f1.a: Yes. The code is open source and self-hosting costs nothing. If we host it for you, you pay only the cloud it consumes — at cost, no margin. Software was never the expensive part; the business model was.

f2.q: Can I migrate my links from Bitly?
f2.a: Yes. Export your links from Bitly as CSV and import them: destinations, aliases and tags come over. Point your old short domain to us and existing links keep working.

f3.q: What happens if Zerosoft shuts down?
f3.a: Nothing bad. The code is open source, so anyone can run it forever. You can export every link and every click at any time, and self-hosting takes one command. Your links can never be held hostage.

f4.a: That is the point. Clone the repo, run it on any server with Node and SQLite, point your short domain, done. No license key, no phone-home, no enterprise tier.

f5.a: Only if you tell them to. Links never expire on their own and never get parked behind a paywall. Expiration is a feature you control, not a threat we use.

meta.description: The Link REST API: create short links, list them and read their stats with a personal API key. Simple, documented, free.

docs.label: 0.05 — API
docs.title: The Link API.
docs.intro: Link exposes a small REST API so your code can create and measure short links. Same rules as everything we make: simple, documented, free.
docs.authP1: Every request needs an API key, sent as a Bearer token:
docs.authP2: Create keys in Dashboard → Settings → API keys. A key is shown exactly once — copy it and store it like a password.
docs.authP3: Each key allows 100 requests per minute. Go over and you get a 429 with a Retry-After header. Need more? Self-host and rate-limit yourself.
docs.createDesc: Creates a short link. slug is optional — leave it out and we generate one.
docs.listDesc: Your links, newest first. Paginate with page and pageSize (max 100).
docs.statsDesc: Click totals and a per-day breakdown for one link.
docs.errorsP: Errors are always JSON with the same shape:
docs.e1desc: The key is missing, wrong or revoked.
docs.e2desc: The url field is missing or is not a valid http(s) URL.
docs.e3desc: That custom slug already exists. Pick another.
docs.e4desc: No link with that id belongs to your account.
docs.e5desc: Over 100 requests in a minute. Wait for Retry-After.
docs.n1: Slugs match {pattern} — letters, numbers, dash and underscore, 2 to 32 characters.
docs.n2: Redirects are public 302s at the root — {example}. No interstitials, no ads, no tracking pages.
docs.n3: Analytics are cookie-less: referrer, country and device come from request headers. Nothing personal is stored.
docs.crmP: The CRM ships with the same API: same keys, same rate limit, same rules. Contacts, companies, deals and tasks — everything the dashboard can do, your code can do.
docs.r1d: List contacts. Filters: q, page, pageSize (max 100).
docs.r10d: Create a deal in a pipeline stage.
docs.r13d: List tasks. bucket: overdue, today, upcoming, done.
docs.r14d: Create a task, optionally linked to a record.
docs.soonP: Track and Cal will ship with the same style of API — REST, JSON, boring in the best way. These docs grow as each product is set free.
